parameters.formDescription: 7 quick questions. Get a personalised checklist by email.

values.fieldLabel: Invoices and receipts are entered by hand
Bank reconciliation takes more than a day each month
New client onboarding uses a manual checklist
Clients ask the same questions repeatedly
Monthly reports are built by hand in spreadsheets
Documents are collected over email chains

parameters.subject: Your personalised automation checklist
parameters.message:
=Hi {{ $("Score And Personalise").item.json.name }},

Thanks for taking the AUDIT. Your personalised checklist is attached. Reply to this email if you want to talk through it.

YOUR_NAME

parameters.subject: =New AUDIT lead: {{ $("Score And Personalise").item.json.name }} ({{ $("Score And Personalise").item.json.score }})
parameters.message:
=Top area: {{ $("Score And Personalise").item.json.actions[0].area }}
Email: {{ $("Score And Personalise").item.json.email }}

parameters.jsCode:
const s = $('Score And Personalise').item.json;
return { json: { date: new Date().toISOString(), name: s.name, email: s.email, firm: s.firm, score: s.score, tier: s.tier, top_area: s.actions[0].area } };

parameters.subject: Did the checklist help?
parameters.message:
=Hi {{ $("Score And Personalise").item.json.name }},

Quick check-in: your biggest opportunity was {{ $("Score And Personalise").item.json.actions[0].area }}. Want a 15-minute walkthrough of how that could be automated?

YOUR_NAME

parameters.subject: A short demo you might like
parameters.message:
=Hi {{ $("Score And Personalise").item.json.name }},

I built a short demo video of an automation like this (on fictional data). Reply DEMO and I will send the link.

YOUR_NAME
